QF.id: AIF Valuation Taxation and Good Practices_40

answer.text: Ongoing reporting, performance updates, supporting investor requirements and grievances, and facilitating exit processes

explanation.text: The Logic: Per NISM XIX-A (pp. 271, 276-277), post-commitment services include liaison on drawdown notices, transfers and paperwork; being a contact point for investor requirements such as periodic reporting and meetings; assisting on capital commitment, drawdowns, co-investments and MFN requests; supporting fund performance discussions, exits and investor grievances; and forwarding documents, performance reports, drawdown notices, closing notices and investor-meeting intimations. The Trap: Service does not end at placement, is not reducible to commission collection, and does not include rash exit advice. Continuing investor support is part of the distributor's standing role. Note: Treat post-investment communication as the relationship's most important phase — investors judge distributors by how well they are supported after the cheque is written.
